node.title: Perl GUI (2013)
node.author: Endless
node.doctext: I am a Perl newbie looking for Perl tools to make an acceptably modern-appearing GUI. Google searches always pop up with Perl/TK but most of the posts I see are a decade old. What is the current best for making an interactive app that doesn't seem to be a blast from the past? If Perl doesn't have any modern GUI facilities, this is a major shortcoming in the language!
